scope: Originals-only, independent of primary candidate/notes; initial judgments preserved for later transparent refinement.

readings.independent_source_first_note: Read all952 Hindi characters. Abu Said reports the Bedouin’s migration question, camel/charity/gift/milking questions and the final across-seas conditional assurance. Keep each actual question, answer and condition. Separate the prefatory multistep route. The appended zakat after the already supplied sadaqah noun appears a lexical clarification rather than a new event; preserve it as context without supplying a modern legal interpretation. No omitted migration command is inferred.

Read all862 Urdu characters independently. The actual Abu Said dialogue retains the unnamed Bedouin, difficult migration, camels, charity, gifts, watering-day milking and conditional no-loss-of-deeds assurance. The route is context. Assess the adjacent sadaqah/zakat parenthesis as a lexical explanation of the explicit noun, preserving all actual predicates and leaving any legal identification source-bound.

Read all771 Hindi characters. Umar’s source-framed statement contrasts revelation-era accountability with his later outward-action policy, retaining good/bad, protection/trust, inner-state and Allah-account conditions. These are Umar’s actual words, not a new Prophet utterance merely because the Prophet period is mentioned. Separate the multistep hearing route while keeping the coherent final Umar reporting predicate and every negation.

Read all721 Urdu characters independently. The complete Umar statement supplies the ended-revelation comparison and his outward-action approach with all conditions and exclusions. Keep its actual Companion voice and both positive/negative branches. Only the prefatory route is apparatus; do not promote the statement to direct Prophet speech or infer a modern rule.

Read all731 Hindi characters. Anas relates two funerals, praise/criticism, both wajib replies, the question and the Prophet’s witness statement. The intervening other-equivalent-words/same-meaning/narrator-doubt clause is formula-comparison apparatus, unlike material location or quantity uncertainty; the actual criticism clause and scene stay. Retain the final accepted-in-divine-court parenthesis because it supplies the predicate of the testimony clause, not merely a synonym. Separate the prefatory chain without adding the unprinted consequence of wajib.

Read all659 Urdu characters independently. Preserve both actual funeral evaluations and replies, the question and final testimony/witness statement. The equivalent-word comparison and its anonymous doubt concern wording rather than another event and belong in visible transmission context. The final مقبول ہے parenthesis supplies a real predicate of the utterance and should remain. No heaven/hell consequence is inserted into the source’s unexpanded wajib.

Read all634 Hindi characters. Aisha reports the Prophet’s arrival, a seated man, who-is-he question, her actual foster-brother answer and the young-age nursing condition. Preserve the house scene and full question/answer. The prefatory chain and final corroborating route are context. The early parenthetic her-foster-brother label duplicates the identity actually given in Aisha’s later answer and appears explanatory; do not remove the actual answer or turn the end route into a second narration.

Read all590 Urdu characters independently. The own Aisha encounter includes arrival at the house, the seated man, question, her foster-brother answer and the age condition. Keep actual location and all speech. Separate the opening route, the final Ibn-Mahdi/Sufyan corroboration and the early duplicate identity apposition; the later actual Aisha identification remains selected and no outside kinship is supplied.

Read all597 Hindi characters. The prefatory route reaches Urwah, whose supplied account gives the unnamed woman’s theft at the conquest and punishment under the Prophet’s order. A separately explicit Aisha frame then reports repentance, marriage and her later presenting the woman’s needs. Preserve those distinct actual voices and the woman’s anonymity; do not retrospectively make Aisha the explicitly named narrator of Urwah’s earlier clause. The double prefatory route is context, while all actual chronology and actions remain.

Read all538 Urdu characters independently. The own Urwah-framed historical account precedes Aisha’s explicit later testimony about repentance, marriage and intercession for needs. Keep both report components, exact chronology and unnamed woman without importing a fuller name or narrator. Separate the prefatory Ismail/Ibn-Wahb/Yunus/Layth routes only; neither finite body is compiler explanation.

Read all1050 Hindi characters. Two printed routes and alternative narrated-to-me/heard-from-him formulas precede Uqbah’s actual marriage, the nursing woman’s claim, his repeated approach and the final instruction. Keep every finite scene, including the source’s withdrew/separated wording without silently construing it as divorce at that earlier point. The nikah and baqi-reh-sakta parentheses supply the actual object and predicate of the how-question and must remain. The multistep routes and equivalent transmission formulas are context; no missing nursing proof or wife identity is inferred.

Read all938 Urdu characters independently. The double route, Bukhari transition and alternative hearing formula are transmission apparatus. The actual Uqbah marriage/nursing-claim encounter, two approaches and prohibition on retaining Umm Yahya remain. Both parenthetic nikah and baqi-reh-sakta complete the supplied rhetorical question, unlike a lexical label. Preserve the literal intervening juda-ho-gaya action and all exact source names without adding a legal conclusion.

Read all503 Hindi characters. The source’s defective short route and printed Abdullah/Ibn-Abi-Of forms must not be repaired. Its price assertion is repeated and omits Urdu’s explicit contrary claim, so do not describe an unprinted false-price predicate as supplied Hindi. Keep the actual oath/price event, the reported revelation with its actual transliterated verse and supplied Hindi meaning, then the separately attributed Companion comparison. The final कहैं and other defects stay literal; no Urdu-derived खائن repair. Pure route is context, while the actual embedded recitation/meaning are preserved with their role distinguished.

Read all565 Urdu characters independently. The own Ibn-Abi-Awfa report explicitly supplies the false-price oath through its contrary clause, then the reported revelation with Arabic verse and its actual Urdu meaning. Keep both recitation and supplied translation as embedded source content, not an external addition. The final named Companion judgment about deceptive price-raising is separately attributed and is not a Prophet saying or compiler dictionary note. Separate the long prefatory route and preserve every actual condition.

Read all576 Hindi characters. The source relays Abu Sufyan’s report of Heraclius recalling his question and Abu Sufyan’s answer about prayer, truth, chastity, covenant and trust, then Heraclius’s own characterization. Keep that actual reported dialogue under Heraclius/Abu Sufyan, not direct Prophet speech. The Muhammad parenthesis supplies the actual otherwise-pronominal subject and should remain; do not infer an absent identity. Separate the prefatory route, preserving a coherent final relay frame and all five listed traits.

Read all501 Urdu characters independently. The actual source ultimately has Heraclius recalling an earlier question/answer to Abu Sufyan and concluding these are prophetic attributes. Preserve those voices and the exact five-part content, without asserting the closing appraisal as our independent conclusion or as a Prophet utterance. The parenthetic Muhammad supplies the referent of وہ and is material participant scope; the multistep preface remains context.

Read all886 Hindi characters. Jabir reports wealth arriving after the Prophet’s death, Abu Bakr’s announcement, Jabir’s own promise claim and three actual five-hundred payments. Preserve all chronology, alternatives and quantities; do not supply a numerical amount inside the earlier Prophet promise. The Bahrain-official parenthesis appears an appended biographical identification of the already named sender and can be context. Keep the printed Hindi sender name without harmonizing Urdu; separate the multistep route only otherwise.

Read all782 Urdu characters independently. The own Jabir report includes the post-death receipt, Abu Bakr’s debt-or-promise announcement, Jabir’s testimony and three five-hundred handovers. The exact source amounts and roles remain, without turning Abu Bakr’s acts into Prophet speech. Assess the Bahrain-official title as a source-preserved biographical apposition; the named sender and actual wealth provenance remain even when that aside is context.

Read all958 Hindi characters. Ibn Abbas’s own admonition and oath, including his source-attributed statements about the People of the Book, remain his sayings rather than our independent historical claims or direct Prophet speech. The worldly-wealth, Quran-identification and repeated People-of-the-Book labels appear explanatory appositions; preserve the actual book/knowledge/questioning predicates around them. The through-your-Prophet clause qualifies the stated revelation-to-you linkage and may remain as material mediation scope. Separate the prefatory route and keep every negative/condition.

Read all872 Urdu characters independently. Keep the full Ibn Abbas admonition/oath under his actual voice. The Quran/worldly-property labels and repeated group identity are explanatory candidates for context. The group apposition has a broken parenthesis: separate only its explicit label and delimiter, never swallow the following سے پوچھنے clause or invent a closing mark. Preserve the actual through-your-Prophet mediation qualifier and all remaining content, with source grammar unchanged.

Read all497 Hindi characters. Sahl reports the Quba dispute escalating to stones, notice to the source’s honorific-designated addressee and the actual let-us-reconcile statement. Preserve this finite scene and command without inserting an explicitly named actor where Hindi supplies only आप with the Prophetic honorific. Separate the multistep preface but keep the final Sahl frame and all source actions.

Read all442 Urdu characters independently. The own Sahl report gives the dispute, stones, notification and reconciliation proposal. The addressed actor is printed as آپ with the honorific; qualify that designation rather than silently adding a name. No participant or outcome is invented. Only the prefatory route is context.

Read all595 Hindi characters. Aisha is explicitly the source speaker of the verse explanation and conditional judgment about an unwanted marriage, the wife’s request and mutual agreement. This is an attributed Companion saying in the numbered report, not a new Prophet utterance or an unassigned compiler gloss. Keep the actual verse/transliterated recitation and supplied Hindi meaning with their role marked. The tafsir-said parenthesis supplies the attribution/purpose frame, and the maintenance qualifier supplies the object of the agreement; both are meaningful. Separate the pure initial route without adding a ruling beyond Aisha’s own conditions.

Read all565 Urdu characters independently. The own Aisha attribution expressly introduces the verse explanation and her mutual-consent judgment; retain that actual Companion voice rather than calling it Prophet speech. Preserve the embedded Arabic verse and source Urdu meaning. The tafsir reporting frame and maintenance object are supplied scope, not blanket-removable parentheses. The husband’s dislike/age, proposed separation, wife’s request and mutual agreement all remain exact; no contemporary legal recommendation is asserted.

Read the entire Bara report: Ali writes the Hudaybiya instrument, the opponents object to Rasul Allah, Ali refuses its deletion, the Prophet deletes it, and the treaty specifies next-year three-day entry with sheathed weapons. Retain Quraysh as the counterparty and next-year as actual participant/time scope. Preserve the printed nested Ali/I-said wording. The final students question and jलबन definition is a lexical teaching appendix, not a new scene in the treaty report; keep that entire appendix in context, as well as the multi-step prefatory route. Do not invent the mechanics of deletion or missing treaty conditions.

Read the complete independently supplied Urdu negotiation, Ali response, deletion and three-day armed-entry conditions. The Quraysh and next-year parentheses supply material party/time scope and remain eligible. The concluding pupils question and explanation of jلبان are an explicitly lexical appendix and should remain context. Preserve the actual nested Ali said/I said wording, all conditions and original source names; do not import alternative accounts.

Read all three treaty clauses, their asymmetric return condition, next-year three-day stay, weapon restrictions, and Abu Jandal in chains being returned. The three parenthetic numbers enumerate actual supplied clauses rather than reference footnotes. His conversion/imprisonment parenthesis supplies the backstory and the agreement-compliance phrase states the narrative basis of his return; my source-first assessment retains these meaningful scene/scope clauses. The ending explicitly marked Imam Bukhari discussion about Muammal omitting Abu Jandal and two spellings of the weapon expression is route/wording apparatus, not another body. Prefix route likewise context.

Read all three Urdu conditions and the Abu Jandal event independently. Retain the actual numbering, asymmetric obligations, three-day limit, captivity/conversion backstory and printed agreement-compliance qualification. Preserve compiler identification but keep his final missing-episode/word-form comparison in visible context, without supplying the absent alternate event. The route before Bara is context, with his coherent report framing retained.

Read Ashath’s Kinda delegation, their esteem for him, his kinship question, and the explicitly attributed Prophet reply about descent and not accusing mother/disowning father. A second narrator-framed habitual Ashath saying threatens his own punishment for denying the stated Quraysh descent. It is a separately attributed Companion saying, not the Prophet’s command; preserve the source-defined later saying separately from the delegation episode. No outside lineage or authenticity claim is supplied.

Read both the Ashath delegation/dialogue and the final narrator-attributed habitual Ashath judgment. Retain each actual speaker and the two complete negations in the first reply. The later first-person enforcement threat is Ashath’s own repeated statement, not an extension of the Prophet’s direct speech. Preserve printed names and the complete later conditional.

Read the entire long Abu Said hearing testimony and ninety-nine/one-hundred murders, repentance, two advisers, departure/death and angel/Iblis dispute. Then read the separately routed Abu Rafi continuation about a deciding angel and the Qatadah/Hasan continuation about dragging towards the good settlement. Keep actual story fragments under their own supplied transmission voices, not an automatically inherited direct Prophetic voice for the later routes. Prefix route lists separating the continuations are context, coherent final-reporter clauses remain. Initial source-first scope assessment: retain the unlawful-killing qualifications, the first adviser’s actually supplied rhetorical question predicate/object and manner, the evil-town causal/location qualification, the resumed dispute-time and adjudication-purpose clauses, and the measure-distance imperative as supplied story/dialogue scope rather than blanket parenthesis cuts. Do not replace the printed Iblis role or infer a missing ultimate speaker for the later variants.

Read every Urdu sentence, including its additional parenthetic angel argument that the repentant man consequently merits mercy, which Hindi does not supply. That clause is initially assessed as the actual in-voice consequence in their dispute, not automatically a lexical gloss. The main Abu Said report and separately transmitted Abu Rafi and Hasan continuations retain qualified distinct voices and their actual finite outcomes. All numeric counts, blame qualifications, rhetorical question complements, causal departure scope, dispute/adjudication scene qualifiers and measure-distance command were read in their own positions. The 1 and 2 footnote glyphs are context. Do not import Hindi wording or erase differences, and do not assign the later continuation to the Prophet without an explicit local link.

Read the whole short Mughirah report of the explicitly attributed Prophet decision assigning diyah to aqilah. The parenthetic killer-family definition is lexical explanatory context, while the supplied technical term and complete responsibility predicate remain. Urdu adds the killer himself to its definition; do not transfer that wording to Hindi or resolve the legal difference externally.

Read the whole source ruling independently. Preserve aqilah and the complete responsibility predicate; the killer-and-family parenthesis is a definition of the already supplied technical term and belongs in visible lexical context. Retain its actual divergence from Hindi’s definition without harmonization.

Read the entire Jariyah report: sword-cut wrist not at the joint, the injured person’s complaint, the compensation decision, request for retaliation, reply/prayer and final explicit non-retaliation outcome. All actual condition, questions, negation and prayer stay; no missing severity, perpetrator name or broader law is inferred.

Read the same source’s own complete injury/complaint/dialogue and final refusal of qisas. Its not-at-the-joint qualification materially defines the scene and stays. The parenthetic khun-baha is merely a synonym for the adjacent diyah and should be context; all other source words and prayer/negation remain.

Read Miswar’s report of Umar consulting about the miscarried child, Mughirah’s first-person attendance/testimony about the Prophet’s slave-or-maid decision, Umar’s witness demand and Muhammad ibn Maslamah’s confirmation. Preserve these nested actual voices and the OR; do not call Umar’s procedure direct Prophet speech or infer details of the prior incident.

Read the full independently supplied consultation and witness dialogue, including its exact final Muhammad ibn Maslamah confirmation. Keep both alternatives in the reported judgment and all attribution roles. The final numbered footnote glyph alone is apparatus context; the final punctuation and report words remain.

Read Ibn Abbas’s account of Umar asking for the Prophet’s ruling and Haml’s standing first-person account of his two wives, tent-pole assault, both deaths and the supplied judgments. The two repeated pet-ke-bachche explanations of janin are lexical context, not extra body. Preserve slave-or-maid alternatives, the separate woman-for-woman judgment and all own event/voice links without inventing a date or legal rationale.

Read the complete consultation, Haml’s two-wife narrative, death of woman and child, and both explicitly attributed decisions. Both repeated janin definitions are visible lexical context; the final footnote marker is context. Keep the supplied OR, two deaths and the nested testimony rather than flattening the entire source as direct Prophet speech.

Read the whole Abdullah ibn Amr report and direct attributed saying: required diyah assigned to asabah, only residue of inheritance for them, and the distinct if-she-is-killed rule about heirs and killing her killer. Wajib, residue, condition and actor restrictions are substantive and remain. The paternal-relatives parenthesis defines asabah and is lexical context; no current legal instruction or external correction is inferred.

Read each Urdu liability/inheritance/conditional clause independently. Preserve wajib, only-the-remainder, the if-killed condition and the exact heirs’ final action. The paternal-relatives gloss merely defines the adjacent technical term and remains in context. Do not merge the two differently situated rulings or broaden their scope.

Read every printed character of the damaged Jabir report. Initial Prophet attribution is explicit; later source prints thahre toh, victim/killer forms and the fragment wasallam) ne farmaya rather than a complete restored honorific or name. Preserve the initial compensation claim, the victim’s agnates’ actual inheritance assertion and the finite husband/son reply under visibly qualified damaged source framing. Do not substitute Urdu’s complete actor wording or silently correct the victim-versus-killer groups. The paternal-relative definition is lexical context only.

Read the complete Jabir narrative: the killer’s agnates bear the victim’s compensation, the printed victim’s agnates claim inheritance, and the explicitly honorific-attributed reply assigns it to husband and son. Preserve those source group identities even if a different edition might differ. The paternal-relatives parenthesis is lexical definition context. Do not let Urdu repair the malformed Hindi frame.
